findings.summary: Snow pickups (% — the mechanic's core verb 'attrape la neige pour grossir') are white six-arm crystals with a white glow on the pale ice backdrop and are nearly invisible at booth distance; the gold coins read fine but the snow the level is built around does not.

The snowball hero is a low-contrast white orb (11+melt·13 px radius, white→#cfe4ff gradient) on white/pale ground — readable only when crossing darker elements, so tracking the ball at booth distance is hard.

The only in-level instruction — the objective banner shown for the first 3.2s — is French-only ('Attrape la neige pour grossir — le soleil monte et fait fondre ta boule…') on an English booth UI, and there is no EN+FR controls string anywhere (level.json has no meta; genre hint is EN-only).

No auto-pause on window blur and the melt keeps running while unfocused (BALL 84%→81% across a 1.2s synthetic blur with keys held) — at a booth kiosk the snowball can melt to the 34% death threshold in roughly 15-20s while the player looks away; the season multiplier (fresh browser → date-derived default AUTOMNE ×1.0, level.json sets no style.season) is likewise invisible in a direct ?level= boot because the season chip lives only on the title screen.

Win path verified end-to-end: the blind keyboard driver WON at t≈5.3 ('LEVEL CLEAR!', ★ 3/3 · BALL 95%) — the spawn snow cluster (+28 pts) plus coins keep the ball well above the 34% melt-death threshold in both runs, so the season/melt mechanic balances in favor of reachable wins.

Rig edge windows unreached (run ended at the t≈5.3 win); manual probe: pause freezes BOTH physics and melt (BALL frozen at 84% while paused), resume/blur/refocus/mash all error-free, mash Escape re-pauses, and retry resets ball+hearts correctly (BALL 62% at spawn → 82% after re-grabbing the spawn snow, hearts ♥♥♥) — zero console/page errors; a second probe run with interruptions LOST ('TRY AGAIN') where the uninterrupted run won, i.e. state survives interruptions and outcomes are timing-sensitive.
Blue flag label 'Boules de Neige' clipped at the right canvas edge beside the pennant.
assets/logo-all.svg and assets/logo-in.svg 404 on every boot (app-level, affects all levels; rig-filtered).
